render/blend-opacity.why: rcpps: tiny-skia's highp recip_fast (color-dodge and color-burn) is _mm_rcp_ps, Go divides exactly

images/images-jpeg.why: decoder: Go's JPEG IDCT differs from zune-jpeg's, by up to 3 levels on about 3.5% of the pixels (chroma upsampling and color conversion are zune-jpeg's)

export/effects.shadows.q1@1.why: encoder: Go's image/jpeg differs from jpeg-encoder in its DCT and quantisation rounding

export/effects.shadows.q80@1.why: encoder: Go's image/jpeg differs from jpeg-encoder in its DCT and quantisation rounding

export/effects.shadows.q100@1.why: encoder: Go's image/jpeg always subsamples chroma 2x2, jpeg-encoder keeps full chroma at quality 90 and above

export/effects.shadows.q80@0.01.why: encoder (DCT and quantisation rounding); the export is a few pixels at the scale clamped from 0.01, so every pixel is a block edge
